generic.instructions: Make the smallest correct change. Preserve existing architecture unless the task requires otherwise.

frontend.instructions: Frontend work: preserve existing UX/design conventions, accessibility and component boundaries. Avoid unrelated redesigns.

backend.instructions: Backend work: keep contracts explicit, validation strict and failures observable. Avoid unnecessary abstraction.

fullstack.instructions: Cross-stack work: keep frontend/backend contracts aligned and avoid duplicating domain logic.

infra.instructions: Infrastructure work: prefer reversible, idempotent changes and conservative resource/security defaults.

testing.instructions: Verification work: test observable behavior and meaningful failures. Keep checks deterministic and CI-friendly.

database.instructions: Database work: preserve data, consider indexes/locking and avoid destructive operations unless explicitly required.

android.instructions: Android work: preserve the repository's XML/Compose choice and lifecycle correctness. Prefer official Android patterns.

docs.instructions: Documentation work: stay concise and describe only behavior that actually exists.
